rv.q: I can pretty much guarantee that you won't see anything as strange, challenging and fascinating on a London stage this year.
Eliot was not much of a playwright and this is more arcane, tortured hagiography than it is tragedy.
Littler's Murder in the Cathedral takes an already beautiful text and then knocks it out of the park in all aspects of the production.

cn.t: Critics praise this audacious staging of T.S. Eliot's verse drama, with David Suchet bringing velvety gravitas and star power to his portrayal of Thomas Becket in a brave and magnificent revival.
